title: Kernels in Coh(X, I): the levels are reductions of stabilized images of levelwise kernels
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space), $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, and $\alpha=(\alpha_n):(\mathcal F_n)\to(\mathcal H_n)$ a morphism of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For $l\ge m\ge1$ let $\operatorname{Ker}\alpha_l\subseteq\mathcal F_l$ be the kernel of $\alpha_l$ in $\mathit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ (sectionwise) and let $\mathcal K'_{l,m}\subseteq\mathcal F_m$ be the image sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image] of the composite $\operatorname{Ker}\alpha_l\hookrightarrow\mathcal F_l\to\mathcal F_m$ of the inclusion and the transition map. Then there is an integer $c\ge0$ such that: (1) $\mathcal K'_{l,m}=\mathcal K'_{m+c,m}$ for all $l\ge m+c$; write $\mathcal K'_m=\mathcal K'_{m+c,m}$; (2) for $m'\ge m$ the transition map $\mathcal F_{m'}\to\mathcal F_m$ maps $\mathcal K'_{m'}$ into $\mathcal K'_m$, and putting $\mathcal K_n=\mathcal K'_{n+c}/\mathcal I^n\mathcal K'_{n+c}$ (notation of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0)) with the transition maps $\mathcal K_{n+1}\to\mathcal K_n$ induced by $\mathcal K'_{n+1+c}\to\mathcal K'_{n+c}$, the system $(\mathcal K_n)_{n\ge1}$ is an object of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$; (3) the maps $\iota_n:\mathcal K_n\to\mathcal F_n$ induced by the inclusion $\mathcal K'_{n+c}\subseteq\mathcal F_{n+c}$ and the isomorphism $\mathcal F_{n+c}/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F_{n+c}\cong\mathcal F_n$ given by the transition maps form a morphism $\iota=(\iota_n):(\mathcal K_n)\to(\mathcal F_n)$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ which is a kernel of $\alpha$ in $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$: $\alpha\circ\iota=0$, and every morphism $\gamma:(\mathcal T_n)\to(\mathcal F_n)$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ with $\alpha\circ\gamma=0$ factors as $\gamma=\iota\circ\delta$ for a unique morphism $\delta$. (The maps $\iota_n$ need not be injective.)

proof.text: Apply the stabilized-image construction to obtain the bound, coherent quotient system, transition and inclusion equations, and eventual vanishing of component kernels.

Use the proved factorization theorem for existence and its shared formalTransition_epi theorem for epimorphic source transitions. Eventual vanishing of component kernels makes the inclusion monic; cancel it for uniqueness. The image-kernel equation and the quotient compatibility equation prove that the composite with alpha is zero.

lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) : ∃ c : ℕ, (∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))) ∧ ∃ (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj), (∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) ∧ ∃ (K : CoherentFormalModule X I) (ι : K ⟶ F) (e : ∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≅ K.obj.obj (op n)), (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 2) (S.obj (op (n + 1 + c))) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom ≫ K.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = S.map (homOfLE (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_succ n) c)).op ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≫ (e n).hom) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≫ (e n).hom ≫ ι.hom.app (op n) = j.app (op (n + c)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n c)).op) ∧ ι ≫ α = 0 ∧ (∀ (T : CoherentFormalModule X I) (γ : T ⟶ F), γ ≫ α = 0 → ∃! δ : T ⟶ K, δ ≫ ι = γ)
